assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic editorial film still. Asset type: wide hero artwork for a fictional independent cinema website. Primary request: original cinematic still for the invented film 'The City at 2:17', no text. Scene: almost empty elevated train platform after midnight, wet pavement, warm fluorescent shelter, a single woman in an orange coat with a small overnight bag stands off-center at the right looking down the tracks. Long quiet perspective, old analog clock visible but small, ordinary urban details. A silver train blurred in the deep background. Composition: landscape 3:2, eye-level wide shot, spacious shadowed left third for later HTML typography. Style: natural 35mm analog film photograph, understated observational cinema, subtle grain, slight halation, tactile damp surfaces. Palette: forest green shadows, amber shelter, chalk-white light, muted orange coat. Lighting: realistic mixed fluorescent and sodium light, subdued and rich, not neon cyberpunk. Constraints: no typography, no film branding, no watermark, no recognizable real person or location, no glossy sci-fi, no excessive lens flare.

Constraints: fictional people, no famous faces, no text, no logos, no watermarks, not stock-photo smiles.
